The requested model was **auto** (which runs a validation tournament to select the best model), but it fell back to tft because: **"nhits unavailable: no GPU worker"**.

This means the nhits model couldn't be evaluated during the auto tournament because there was no GPU worker available at the time, so the system used the tft model instead.
